label: Squared Bottom
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: After a 6x upscale of the lower third the hem is a straight horizontal line with no front cutaway and no radius: the front closure edge meets the hem at a right-angle corner on both sides. That is the squared-bottom geometry the label names, and it is consistent with a double-breasted front, which is always cut square.

At 6x upscale the hem line is level and I see no rounded front cutaway, consistent with a squared bottom; however the front corner sits in shadow at only 169x254 px, so the corner geometry is not unambiguous. The jacket being double-breasted makes a square hem likely rather than proven by the pixels.
